title: Class H Preferred Stock Dividend Rate Schedule by Size of Share Basis — Member Equities & Patronage
content:
The annual rate at which the quarterly dividend on a Member Equities & Patronage Class H Preferred Stock holding is figured is the dividend bracket rate, read against the holding's dividend share basis — the shares on which the quarter's dividend is figured.

## Rate brackets

| Dividend share basis | Dividend bracket rate (% per year) |
|---|---|
| 100000 or more | 4.5 |
| 50000 or more but below 100000 | 4.375 |
| Below 50000 | The declared annual dividend rate of Class H Preferred Stock (4.25 in the current class schedule) |

A basis of 100000 or more carries 4.5 percent; a basis of 50000 or more but below 100000 carries 4.375 percent; a basis below 50000 carries the declared dividend rate of the class.

## Edges of the brackets (hypothetical bases)

| Dividend share basis | Bracket rate |
|---|---|
| 49,999.99 | 4.25 — below 50000 |
| 50,000.00 | 4.375 — exactly 50000 is in the middle bracket |
| 99,999.99 | 4.375 |
| 100,000.00 | 4.5 — exactly 100000 is in the top bracket |

The bracket is read on the dividend share basis as it stands, unrounded.
